title: Future Fish Decision
goal: Decide whether a small fish population is appropriate after the pond has proven stable through Arizona seasons.
reviewCriteria: Review summer water temperature and oxygen/aeration needs.
Confirm the mechanical and biological filtration is mature and adequate.
Review algae performance; add a UV clarifier only if persistent green-water algae becomes a problem.
Choose only a conservative number of small fish if conditions support them.
maintenanceNotes: UV is optional future equipment for free-floating green-water algae only; it does not solve string algae, wall algae or debris.
Continue routine debris removal, filter cleaning and water-level checks before adding more equipment.

items.note: Only consider if persistent green-water algae develops after the pond has been running with normal filtration and maintenance.

shoppingList.note: No fish or UV purchases are committed now.

completionMemory.title: End of Phase 7
completionMemory.caption: Reserved for the future fish and long-term pond-health decision if this phase is activated.
